attends(V) => souvenirs(V). @ "Everyone who attends the conference in person is provided with souvenirs."

meals(V) => happy(V). @ "Everyone provided with delicious meals is happy to communicate with each other during the dinner."

not attends(james) | not souvenirs(james). @ "It is not true that James both attended the conference in person and was provided with souvenirs."
